preregistered.transpilation: the service re-transpiles every iteration, so each model's prediction is computed on the computed_circuit the iteration returns; the same body compiles to the same meshes on sim:belenos and qpu:belenos while the couplers are unchanged
preregistered.classes: phase noise, coupler noise, heater gain, thermal crosstalk, a phase ceiling and a demultiplexer misroute (source models) each predict a different histogram per returned mesh
preregistered.decision: each class's magnitude scan (exact dephasing channel, heater gain, thermal crosstalk, misroute plus noise) is scored by efficiency-weighted multinomial likelihood on the returned meshes; the best class fits only when the chi-square p-value of its deviance, with bins expected below 5 counts pooled into one rest bin floored at one count once it saw a click, is at least 0.001 at its degrees of freedom and the median ratio of setting TVD to its shot-noise floor is at most 3, and otherwise the job reads 'no class fits'; a best point at every class's null magnitude reads 'ideal'; one shared static heater-offset vector, fitted by MAP on three folds of settings and scored on the fourth, is the static class and wins when its held-out gain exceeds 10 nats; a misroute is read from the likelihood of the source models on the returned meshes, whose unused columns are transpiler draws
